results.statement: A parity table under docs/plans/phase-m/ must record whether sc-lint covers each of atm-core's boundary settings manifest_dependency_allowlists, global_dependency_ownership and manifest_section_rules.
results.quote:
sc-lint enforces dependency ownership on source files only, and we know which of atm-core's three boundary settings it already covers.
Definition question (team-lead, 2026-10-30): "we know = written in a parity table in the Phase M docs for manifest_dependency_allowlists, global_dependency_ownership, manifest_section_rules" Rand: "yes"
results.context: Phase M planning; Rand approved the sentence and answered 'yes' to the definition question, relayed by team-lead 2026-10-30
results.deterministic_check: docs/plans/phase-m/ contains a parity table with one covered/not-covered row for each of the three settings.
